scope: Fork-only Windows x64 Rust full PGO release-build storage experiment
upstream_runner_difference: Upstream dist-x86_64-msvc uses windows-2025-8core-32gb; this experiment uses a standard hosted runner and cannot estimate that larger runner's wall time.

prior_art.conclusion: Inconclusive; CPU-confounded NVMe subset. Windows 2022 ordinary ReFS, not Arm Dev Drive.

treatment.control: Stock NTFS workspace, Cargo and temporary locations.
treatment.refs: Shrink eligible D without deleting it; format only newly created R as ordinary ReFS. Move workspace, Cargo home and runner temp using verified copies, retained originals and junctions; put TEMP/TMP on R.
treatment.retained_ntfs: Maximum of supported minimum, 32 GiB, and used bytes plus 16 GiB, rounded up to MiB; require at least 80 GiB reclaimed.
treatment.difference_from_prior: NTFS reserve avoids the nearly-full D and pagefile-growth constraint of the prior minimum-size shrink.
treatment.causal_scope: Combined partition/filesystem/directory relocation; not ReFS alone or an NTFS-to-NVMe move.

sampling.pilot: One cold pair followed by restored-cache jobs, gated on hosted storage safety. Excluded from confirmatory estimates.
sampling.confirmatory: Six fixed nominal blocks, two variants in each cache mode, launched only after full pilot feasibility. No performance-dependent top-ups.
sampling.ordering: Alternate declared variant order across blocks; GitHub controls actual scheduling and hardware assignment.
sampling.primary: NVMe-backed, hardware-matched nominal blocks only. SAS is a separate secondary stratum. Never call nominal scheduling blocks matched physical hosts.
sampling.minimum: At least three successful matched NVMe blocks in each cache mode; otherwise the primary comparison is inconclusive.
sampling.cache: Cold empty local sccache; restored jobs use each variant's own successful cold cache on a fresh VM. No source/build outputs restored; not upstream private S3 cache equivalence.

measurement.primary: Job start through successful Stage 5 final distribution completion; includes storage/setup/downloads and PGO, excludes subsequent artifact tests and cache upload.
secondary: release command including upstream artifact tests
measurement.cpu: Whole-VM busy CPU, not raw process-tree compile CPU.
measurement.timing: Monotonic measured command time; UTC milestone and API job/step times. Preserve all raw evidence.
measurement.limits: 360-minute job; 330-minute measured command budget leaves evidence handling time. Failure/timeout/space exhaustion is not a completed-build observation. Report distribution-complete but qualification-failed separately.
measurement.qualification: Full opt-dist windows-ci without DIST_TRY_BUILD; all upstream tests, distribution manifest, extracted compiler execution. MSI install/upgrade not tested.

decision.report: Per-block seconds, paired reductions, median and observed range. Fixed-seed 10000-resample block bootstrap interval is exploratory with few blocks, not proof of a universal speedup.
decision.follow_up: All correctness gates pass; at least three matched NVMe blocks per mode; median production reduction at least 5% in both cache modes and no matched block regression above 5%. Strong positive claim additionally requires the bootstrap interval to exclude no improvement.
decision.incomplete: No extrapolated full-release speedup from partial phases, timeouts, unmatched hosts, or the IronRDP workload.
